items.title: Eddie B. Edwards Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: they got Frankie Signorelli I was in the army at that time and they got Frankie Signorelli to take his place

ctx.x: and after you got to New York you had the same band as we stated now yeah the Rising Webbers were there any changes there ever in Rising Webbers?

no that was uh except when Regis passed away Russell Robinson joined the band and uh he left and they got Frankie Signorelli I was in the army at that time and they got Frankie Signorelli to take his place then when they went to Europe Russell wished to go to Europe and he did go for I think six months and he came back and they got a man by the name of the Jones Billy Jones to play piano in London and then when they came back I booked them at the uh Foley-Bergé that was 50th in Broadway for the Salvin brothers…
I was wondering when you were out of the band in the army who took your place? Emil Christian played trombone only Christian that's right and uh did Christian make any
